title: Typewriter
description: Revolver's liner credits on a flat sheet of cream bond, and nothing of the machine but the stamper that strikes it. Every key bites the paper with its own worn, uneven ink; Return throws the carriage home and rolls the sheet up a line.
intent: The machine pared back to the sheet and the stamper so the strike is the subject: real strikes on real paper, every letter landing a little differently, the carriage moving with weight.
